name: bluesky
description: Replies, mentions and quotes from your Bluesky notifications, read through Bluesky's own API with an app password. Read-only: it never posts, likes, follows or marks anything as read.

requires.help: In Bluesky, open Settings, Privacy and security, App passwords, and add one. Leave "Allow access to your direct messages" switched off. Save it in that file as { "handle": "you.bsky.social", "appPassword": "xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx" } and run chmod 600 on the file. Never use your main password. Steps: extractors/bluesky/README.md.
